# mp4v2 source placeholder

Place mp4v2 source code here (for example by cloning the repository into this folder):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TechSmith/mp4v2.git third_party/mp4v2
```

When `third_party/mp4v2/CMakeLists.txt` exists, the project will auto-add it in CMake and try linking target `mp4v2`.
